overview: White plays 3.e4 against the Dutch with 2.Nc3 d5, offering the e-pawn to blow open the centre. After 3...fxe4 White plays f3 or Bg5 and tries to use the lead in development and the weakened black kingside. Black can take the pawn and hold with careful play.

white_ideas.idea: Open the centre and attack with f3, Bg5 and Qd2

black_ideas.idea: Accept the pawn and cover the king
Return it at the right time and develop

typical_structures.structure: Weakened black king-side with f-pawn gone

character.notes: White attacks at once with material down, so play is forcing.

gambit.notes: Black can take e4 and hold with a careful defence.

soundness.notes: Black's best defences leave White without full compensation.

structure.notes: The centre and f-file are opened early.

sublines_that_differ.name: Declined 3...dxe4
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 f5 2. Nc3 d5 3. e4 dxe4
sublines_that_differ.how: Black takes with the d-pawn and keeps a Dutch-style structure

character.reason: White sacrifices at once for the initiative.

gambit.reason: White gives e4 and Black can keep it.

soundness.reason: Black's extra pawn and sound play are hard to meet.

level.reason: Dubious lines are not beginner level.

plans.reason: White aims at the exposed black king-side.
